dedupe_keys.name: analyzing pre and post coastal hazard pavement conditions to optimize response strategies for coastal infrastructure resilience

description: Xiaohua Luo publishes selected pavement-condition and maintenance analyses before and after Hurricane Harvey in Texas. Zenodo lists a public ZIP and short README under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The README identifies processed TxDOT pavement records by asphalt, continuously reinforced concrete and jointed concrete type, prediction comparisons from linear regression and Random Forest, and NOAA rainfall for seven Texas counties. These data can test how storm exposure and maintenance choices affect road-condition or recovery simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this processed Harvey pavement release. A limitation is that the complete raw TxDOT PMIS dataset is withheld under data-sharing restrictions, so the Zenodo bundle cannot reconstruct every source observation. The deposit contains analysis outputs, not a validated physical pavement-deterioration model. No ZIP was downloaded, and before-after effects or prediction accuracy were not independently checked.
